CREATE TABLE driver_paths(id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES drivers(id),track_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    profile TEXT NOT NULL,policy TEXT,checkpoint TEXT,steps INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    seconds REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,policy_profile TEXT,candidate TEXT,curriculum TEXT,
                    PRIMARY KEY(id,track_id));

CREATE TABLE history(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,driver TEXT NOT NULL,
                    kind TEXT NOT NULL,created TEXT NOT NULL,payload TEXT NOT NULL, track_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'oval-1');

CREATE TABLE path_initializers(id TEXT NOT NULL,track_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    policy TEXT NOT NULL,source TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(id,track_id));

CREATE TABLE profile_paths(id TEXT NOT NULL,track_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    path_key TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(id,track_id,path_key));

CREATE TABLE sessions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,mode TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,
                    created TEXT NOT NULL,updated TEXT NOT NULL,payload TEXT NOT NULL);
